newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to see upside limited to 128.82.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to see upside limited to 128.82.

text.p: June Notionnel futures traded on MATIF were expected to move slightly higher and fill the gap left on daily charts on Wednesday but any further gains were likely to be limited, technical analysts said.
"We are looking for a gradual filling of the gap as intraday momentum was non-confirming of recent lows," said Nicholas Rose, technical analyst at 4CAST in London.
The gap is between the low on Friday of 128.82 and Monday's high at 128.58.
At 0815 GMT, June notionnel futures were trading just above the bottom of that gap at 128.60, up 16 basis points on the day.
Rose said first resistance was at 128.78, Thursday's low, with 128.82 as the target above there, but the contract was not likely to get much higher for now.

"We will probably see some exhaustion on further rallies," he said. "Intra-day momentum is already close to overbought levels but implied losses from this overbought structure should prove exhaustive."
To the downside, Rose noted support at 128.08, Tuesday's low, with a further prop at 128.04, the low on April 4.
He said if the bear channel remained intact continuation to the 127.44, 127.48 early April break area was possible.
"But that is unlikely because the rising intra-day momentum is keeping the upside highlighted and daily momentum is floating around oversold areas," Rose said.
Technical analysts at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London said the notionnel would stabilise short-term and move higher to fill the gap up to 128.78.
"Strong resistances are found at 129.06, and the downtrend near 129.22," they said, adding that these gains would be short-lived.
A 38 percent Fibonacci retracement of the decline from 130.76 on May 16 to 128.08 on Tuesday comes in around 129.06.
At the short end, June Pibor futures were at 96.31, up 0.01 on the day.
